items.q: What should you remember about **AI increases hiring noise**?
items.a: **5,000 outreach emails per** hire; spam destroys signal; scarcity restores meaning.

items.q: What should you remember about **Augment recruiters, don't replace**?
items.a: **paid $50M+ to recruiters;** opposite of "AI replaces recruiters" narrative.

items.q: What should you remember about **Trust > talent graph**?
items.a: **finding great engineers is** easy; getting response requires relationship/access.

items.q: What should you remember about **Referral bounties failed**?
items.a: **overestimated network size; casual referrers don't return.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Professional recruiters retained**?
items.a: **it's their job, they're connected, financially motivated.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Quality over quantity matching**?
items.a: **3–4 curated fits beats infinite choice overload.**

items.q: What should you remember about **70/20 AI-human split**?
What should you remember about **$40K/hire willingness**?
items.a: **founders validated problem before** building; five hires/year = salary equivalent.

items.q: What should you remember about **Dig to root cause**?
What should you remember about **110% problem conviction**?
items.a: **stay in hiring space** through failed pivots; don't idea-hop.

items.q: What should you remember about **3-year horizon urgency**?
items.a: **health scare → prioritize** now; false alarm but mindset stuck.

items.q: What should you remember about **Hightouch proof point**?
items.a: **18-month open role filled** in 6 weeks → customer-led seed intro.
